prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied NexoFolio webpage screenshot into a privacy-safe onboarding guide. This input is the edit target, not stylistic inspiration. Preserve the screenshot layout, all controls, original text and geometry as faithfully as possible; do not invent UI. Keep the full original wide framing. Cover the top-right personal avatar and account name with an opaque neutral light-gray rounded mask. Also cover only the business project name next to 当前项目 within the dropdown, while keeping 当前项目 readable. These areas must be fully unreadable, not weak blur. Leave the navigation labels 接口文档 and MCP 凭证 and the rest of the menu unchanged. Add two elegant small blue/purple numbered labels with thin leader arrows, placed in unused whitespace, never red: '1 打开「接口文档」' pointing to the open header menu, and '2 进入「MCP 凭证」' pointing to the MCP menu item. Do not cover either target label. Keep all background and page text unchanged outside privacy masks and guide annotations. This is a navigation illustration, not a fabricated product state. Opaque white background, no transparency.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied NexoFolio MCP credentials screenshot for a privacy-safe onboarding guide. Preserve the complete wide composition, layout, original controls and all nonprivate text, especially the exact service URL https://nexofolio.net/api/mcp, the labels MCP 凭证, 服务地址, Streamable HTTP, 复制, 创建凭证. Do not invent or remove controls. Irreversibly cover with opaque neutral light-gray masks: the top-right personal avatar and account name; the name in the '凭证属于 ...' line; the numeric accessible-project count; the credential count; the entire personal credential data row below the table headings (credential name, ID, creation and expiry dates, status, revoke). Preserve table headings. Do not leave any personal name, alias, ID or dates readable in these masked areas. Add two refined blue/purple numbered guide labels with thin leader arrows in unused whitespace, never red: '1 复制服务地址' pointing to the 复制 button, and '2 创建专用凭证' pointing to 创建凭证. Keep both controls and the URL readable. No other changes, no decorative elements, no generated business data. This is a privacy-edited navigation illustration. Opaque background, no transparency.
